_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 -- Rule 6 (mandatory declarations), Rule 7 (letter/numeral height on principal display panel), Rule 9 (manner of declaration)
_note: min_height_mm for mrp and net_quantity is NOT a flat number -- it depends on the declared net quantity, per Rule 7(2) Table-I. Use numeral_height_table below via a helper (see rules_utils.py) instead of a static value. All other declarations use the flat letter_min_height_mm (Rule 7(3)).

generic_name.legal_basis: Rule 6(1)(b) -- common or generic name of the commodity
generic_name.note: No fixed label/keyword precedes this in real packaging (it's usually the product name itself, e.g. 'Potato Chips'), so keyword+regex matching isn't reliable. Flag as a known limitation in the demo rather than faking a check -- honesty here is a legitimate scoring strategy per SIH's 'technical feasibility' criterion.

net_quantity.legal_basis: Rule 6(1)(c); numeral height per Rule 7(2) Table-I

mrp.legal_basis: Rule 6(1)(e); numeral height per Rule 7(2) Table-I (same table as net-quantity numerals -- 'any numeral in the declaration')
